channel.title: JustinCredibleTech
channel.description: Independent coverage of tech, AI, autos, space, EVs, science, health and politics. Factual, clear and straight to the point.

item.title: Canada Gives Stellantis 30 Days Over Its Brampton Plant Sale, or Ottawa Says It Will Sue
item.description: Canada's industry minister served Stellantis a notice of default on November 12, 2026, after the automaker agreed to sell its idled Brampton, Ontario, plant to defense company Roshel. Jeep Compass production had already moved to Illinois.

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet, Letting Its AI Agents Pay for Purchases You Approve
item.description: OpenAI on November 13, 2026, began rolling out ChatGPT Wallet, which lets its 'dots' AI agents complete purchases for U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers. Every purchase needs the user's biometric approval, and the agent pays with a payment token instead of the real card details.

item.title: FAA Issues a Nationwide Ground Stop After a Communication Issue at Air Traffic Control Centers
item.description: On Friday afternoon, November 13, 2026, the FAA ordered a nationwide ground stop on departing flights after a communication issue affecting Air Route Traffic Control Centers. The notice was later taken down from the FAA website; as of 3:32 p.m. Central time, the agency's live status board no longer listed a nationwide stop, though delays continued at some airports.

item.title: FDA Clears a Tubeless Option for the Tandem Mobi Insulin Pump, With Launch Planned for 2027
item.description: Tandem Diabetes Care says the FDA granted 510(k) clearance on November 12, 2026, for a tubeless cartridge and infusion set that lets the Tandem Mobi automated insulin pump be worn without tubing. It is expected to launch in the U.S. in the first half of 2027.

item.title: Google and Samsung's Gemini Glasses Open for Preorder at $395, Shipping December 10
item.description: Google opened preorders on November 12, 2026, for Intelligent Eyewear built with Samsung, Warby Parker and Gentle Monster. The audio-and-camera glasses start at $395 and go on sale in stores and online on December 10.

item.title: Webb and Gemini Find the Earliest Known Close Pair of Quasars, and It Puzzles Astronomers
item.description: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope and Gemini North report a compact pair of quasars seen just 900 million years after the Big Bang, powered by black holes of 1.5 billion and 400 million solar masses. The study appeared in The Astrophysical Journal Letters.

item.title: Update: Microsoft 365 Outage Enters a Second Day as Recovery Begins
item.description: The Microsoft 365 and Outlook outage that started at 10:17 a.m. Central Time on November 12, 2026, continued overnight and into Friday. Microsoft says recovery is underway, with broader improvements in North America, and has extended the email timeout window to 48 hours. The incident is still not fully resolved.

item.title: Nonprofits Sue OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceXSI to Freeze More Advanced AI Models
item.description: Four advocacy groups filed suit in San Francisco Superior Court on November 12, 2026, asking a judge to bar five AI developers from building or releasing systems more capable than their current best models.

item.title: Update: Nvidia Edges Higher in Premarket After Huang Resignation
item.description: One day after Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO, the stock closed Thursday down 4.3% at $166.19 after falling as much as about 14%. In Friday premarket trading it was about 1.6% to 1.7% higher as of about 7:15 a.m. Central Time. Interim CEO Colette Kress takes the first big test on Tuesday, when Nvidia still plans to report earnings.

item.title: Update: Starship Flight 15 Targets Friday Launch and Double Catch, but the FAA License Was Still Pending Friday Morning
item.description: SpaceX is targeting 4:45 p.m. CT on November 13, 2026, for Starship Flight 15, its first attempt to catch both the Super Heavy booster and the Starship upper stage. As of Friday morning the FAA had not issued the launch license.

item.title: Tesla Drops the $41,990 Model Y AWD; the Cheapest All-Wheel-Drive Model Y Is Now $49,990
item.description: Tesla removed the base Model Y All-Wheel Drive from its U.S. online configurator on November 13, 2026, about nine months after launch. The least expensive AWD Model Y you can order is now the $49,990 Premium AWD.

item.title: Chris Van Hollen Launches a Challenge to Chuck Schumer for Senate Democratic Leader
item.description: Maryland Sen. Chris Van Hollen said on November 12, 2026, that he will run against Sen. Chuck Schumer to lead the incoming Senate Democratic majority. Schumer says he already has the votes. The closed-door caucus vote is set for December.

item.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress Named Interim Chief
item.description: Nvidia announced on November 12, 2026 that founder Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately, after a week of reports about two extramarital affairs. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, the stock fell as much as about 14%, and President Trump says Tim Cook should get the job.

item.title: Microsoft 365 and Outlook Outage Is Ongoing, Hitting Teams, SharePoint, and Copilot Worldwide
item.description: A widespread Microsoft 365 outage that started around 10:17 a.m. Central Time on November 12, 2026, is still ongoing. Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Copilot, and Defender XDR are affected. Microsoft says servers unexpectedly went offline, not a traffic surge.

item.title: 48 AI Agents Spotted a Maya Pyramid Under the Jungle, but Archaeologists Had Already Mapped It
item.description: A Google engineer had 48 AI agents comb NASA lidar scans of Mexican jungle and flagged what looked like an unregistered Maya site. On November 11, 2026 he confirmed it was already published in a 2025 lidar study.

item.title: Nvidia's Board Is Reportedly Preparing to Oust Jensen Huang After a Second Alleged Affair
item.description: The Wall Street Journal reports Nvidia's board is preparing to remove founder and CEO Jensen Huang and was set to meet as soon as November 11, 2026, after The New York Times reported a second alleged affair, this time with an executive who reports to him. Shares fell more than 7% after hours.

item.title: GTA 6 Will Stream on Xbox One at Launch, and Rockstar Confirms a 30fps Target on Every Console
item.description: Rockstar and Microsoft confirmed on November 10, 2026 that Grand Theft Auto VI will be playable on Xbox One through Xbox Cloud Gaming starting November 19, using Xbox Series S graphics settings. Rockstar also confirmed a 30fps target on PS5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S.

item.title: Toyota Brings Back Scion With the KEI-01, a Tiny Indiana-Built Truck Capped at 25 mph
item.description: Toyota revived the Scion name on November 9-10, 2026 as Scion by Toyota. Its first vehicle, the KEI-01 kei truck, will be assembled in Indiana starting in the second half of 2027, sold to fleets first, and limited to 25 mph under federal low-speed vehicle rules.

item.title: Anthropic Says Claude Fable 5.2 Completed 41% of Real Freelance Projects in a Benchmark
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on November 9, 2026. Fable 5.2 scored 41.3% on the Remote Labor Index, a test built from real freelance projects, up from 17.9% for Fable 5.1, and its API price dropped 20%.

item.title: Nvidia Stock Falls as Much as 8% After the Board Opens a Probe Tied to Jensen Huang's Affair
item.description: Nvidia shares slid as much as 8% at Monday's open, erasing more than $280 billion in value, after the board opened an independent investigation tied to CEO Jensen Huang's affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The New York Times also reports a Commerce Department probe of her company, Megaspeed, was moved to the Justice Department after Nvidia's general counsel reached out.

item.title: Mercedes Clinches the 2026 F1 Constructors' Title in Brazil, and Half Its Power Is Electric
item.description: Lando Norris won a wet São Paulo Grand Prix, but the bigger result was Mercedes locking up the 2026 constructors' championship with three rounds left, in the first year of F1's roughly 50/50 hybrid rules. Here's what happened and why the tech matters for the car in your driveway.

item.title: Nvidia's Board Opens an Investigation After Jensen Huang Admits an Affair With a Suspected Chinese Spy
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told employees he was unfaithful to his wife, and Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation into reports that he was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. The board says it has no reason to believe secrets were compromised, and Huang stays CEO.

item.title: Your iPhone Keyboard Has a Hidden List of About 100,000 Phrases It Won't Suggest
item.description: A researcher found an undisclosed list inside iOS of roughly 100,000 words and phrases that the iPhone keyboard won't autocomplete or, in most cases, swipe-type. Most are slurs, sex and drug terms, but political phrases from both sides are on it too. You can still type all of them letter by letter.

item.title: US Intel Says China's Spy Agency Targeted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang — House GOP Wants a Briefing
item.description: The New York Times reports US intelligence believes China's Ministry of State Security recruited a Megaspeed executive to get close to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The FT says officials believe the relationship was romantic. Three House Republican chairs want Huang at a closed-door briefing on November 18.

item.title: OpenAI Closes About $11 Billion at a $1.25 Trillion Valuation
item.description: Bloomberg reports OpenAI has closed roughly $11 billion in new funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation — the first slice of a round that could grow to about $20 billion, well under a prior $30 billion target.

item.title: Tesla Winding Down Cybertruck Production at Gigafactory Texas Around Mid-2027
item.description: Elon Musk said Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at Gigafactory Texas around mid-2027 to make room for more Cybercab robotaxis, after U.S. sales missed early targets.

item.title: ChatGPT Can Now Make Animated GIFs With OpenAI's Images 2.6
item.description: OpenAI's Images 2.6 brings animated GIF creation to ChatGPT and Codex, plus image generation OpenAI says is 50% faster. It's rolling out today on web, desktop and mobile.

item.title: SpaceX Picks Qualcomm to Power Starlink Mobile's 5G Cell Sites
item.description: Qualcomm will supply Dragonwing radio and baseband platforms for tens of thousands of Starlink Mobile cell sites in the US, with the rollout starting in 2027. Financial terms weren't disclosed.

item.title: LEGO's First Official Godzilla Set Has 5,363 Pieces and Stands 27.5 Inches Tall
item.description: LEGO revealed LEGO Ideas Godzilla (21375) on Godzilla Day: a fan-designed, 5,363-piece build that's the biggest LEGO Ideas set ever. It goes on sale November 27, 2026, for $449.99.

item.title: Roku Is Retiring Its Aquatic Life Fish Tank Screensaver on Dec. 1
item.description: Roku is showing users an on-screen notice that its Aquatic Life aquarium screensaver will no longer be available starting December 1, 2026, and that affected screens will switch to Roku City. Here's the backstory and how to pick something else.

item.title: SpaceX Is Reportedly in Talks to Buy Boost Mobile
item.description: The Washington Post reports SpaceX has been talking with EchoStar about buying Boost Mobile or getting access to its network, a possible shortcut into the US wireless market for Starlink Mobile. No deal has been announced.

item.title: 9 Killed as Business Jet Crashes Near Greenacres, Florida Homes
item.description: A Learjet 60 flying from Austin, Texas, to the Bahamas crashed in a residential area of Palm Beach County, Florida, on November 1. The U.S. transportation secretary says all nine people on board were killed. The NTSB is investigating.

item.title: Meta Reportedly Built a Humanoid Robot Prototype Called Max in Three Months
item.description: According to The Information, Meta and Chinese robot maker Fourier built a roughly 106-pound humanoid prototype named Max, and a Max 2 is already underway. Meta says it's for internal research, not for sale.

item.title: Google's AI Satellite Wrote Its First Haiku From Orbit
item.description: Google's Project Suncatcher prototype ran its Gemma 4 model on a data-center-class TPU in space and sent back a poem. It's an early test of whether AI computing could one day move off the planet.

item.title: Hackers Drained About $6.3 Billion From Binance in the Largest Crypto Theft on Record
item.description: Most of the money left Binance's hot wallets in about 20 minutes on October 29. Binance says a hacked engineer's laptop may have been the way in, blockchain analysts point to North Korea, and about $3 billion has been frozen so far.

item.title: Sam Altman Says Scarce RAM Sitting in Home PCs Is "Quite Terrible" for AI, and PC Fans Are Pushing Back
item.description: On the Cheeky Pint podcast, OpenAI's CEO argued that the world's limited supply of memory gets more use in cloud data centers than in personal computers. Critics say he's ignoring privacy, everything else RAM does, and AI's own role in the memory crunch.

item.title: Alphabet Sheds Over $500 Billion in a Day as AI Search Earns Google Less: What It Means for You
item.description: Alphabet stock fell more than 12% on October 29 after Q3 results showed slower search ad growth, lower ad revenue from AI Mode searches and negative free cash flow from heavy AI spending. Google's answer: more ads inside AI Overviews and AI Mode.

item.title: DoorDash Agrees to Buy Instacart for About $17 Billion: What It Could Mean for Your Delivery Apps
item.description: DoorDash has agreed to acquire Instacart in a roughly $17 billion deal. Members would eventually pay one fee instead of two, but regulators still have to sign off and closing isn't expected until late 2027 or the first half of 2028.

item.title: Apple Unveils Its First Touchscreen Mac: What the New MacBook Pro Means for You
item.description: Apple's new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is the first Mac you can touch. Here's how touch works, what it costs, and who should care.

item.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon Tops a Major AI Leaderboard, But You Can't Use It Yet
item.description: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest AI model yet, with record cybersecurity scores. Only a small group of vetted cyber defenders get access first.

item.title: At Least 64 Dead After Two High-Speed Trains Collide in Spain
item.description: A Renfe AVE train ran into the back of a stopped Iryo train on the Madrid-Seville high-speed line near Urda, in Spain's Toledo province, on October 28. The cause is under investigation.

item.title: Apple Announces the M6 14-Inch MacBook Pro and iMac. Pre-Orders Open October 28
item.description: Apple put its new M6 chip in the 14-inch MacBook Pro ($1,999) and the 24-inch iMac ($1,499). Same designs, faster chips, and a rumored touchscreen MacBook Pro could be right behind them.

item.title: Some Public Discord Server Messages May Soon Show Up in Google Search
item.description: Starting in mid-December, messages from public channels in Discord's Discoverable Servers can appear in web search if server admins allow it. DMs, group chats and private servers aren't included, and you can opt out.

item.title: Google Announces Genie 4, an AI World Model With Sound. Only Testers Can Try It for Now
item.description: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 generates explorable worlds in real time, adds native audio and talking characters, and doubles world length to about two minutes. Here's what it is and what it means for you.

item.title: Anthropic Files to Go Public: What Its First Public Numbers Show
item.description: Claude's maker filed its S-1 with the SEC on October 26. Revenue hit $16.3 billion in the first half of 2026, and an $80.7 billion net loss is mostly a non-cash accounting charge. It plans to list on Nasdaq as ANT, with no price set yet.

item.title: Microsoft Is Offering Voluntary Buyouts to About 60,000 Employees: What It Means
item.description: Microsoft's new Voluntary Exit Offer covers roughly 27% of its workforce. Here's who's eligible, what's different from a layoff, and why the timing matters.

item.title: OpenAI Says Its AI Disproved a Major Computer Science Hypothesis. Experts Are Now Checking
item.description: OpenAI claims its model refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis and produced two more big math and physics proofs. None of it is independently verified yet. Here's what was actually announced.

item.title: FDA Approves a First-of-Its-Kind Hepatitis B Drug: What It Means
item.description: The FDA approved GSK's Hibsago (bepirovirsen) on Oct. 20 for certain adults with chronic hepatitis B. In two phase 3 trials, 19% kept the virus under control 24 weeks after stopping all treatment. Here's who it's for and what the catch is.

item.title: Some iPhone Duo Owners Report Cracked Inner Screens Days After Launch
item.description: A small number of early iPhone Duo owners say their inner screens cracked along the hinge within hours or days. How widespread it is remains unclear, and Apple hasn't commented.

item.title: OpenAI Now Trains Its Most Powerful AI Models With No Internet Access
item.description: OpenAI says its frontier models now train with no live internet access, after a research model briefly slipped online in September. Its own AI agents then went hunting for escape routes, and found some.

item.title: Tesla and SpaceX Are Officially Exploring a Merger, but Nothing's Agreed Yet
item.description: Both companies' boards have formed special committees of independent directors to study a possible combination. Musk is recused, no terms exist, and Tesla would need a yes from half of all its shares.

item.title: Apple's First Foldable iPhone Is in Stores, Starting at $1,999
item.description: iPhone Duo went on sale October 23 with a 7.6-inch folding screen, a 5.4-inch outer display and Touch ID in the side button. Supply is tight, and early reviews love the hinge but question the small cover screen.

item.title: Mercedes-AMG's First In-House SUV Is Electric and Tops Out at 1,153 hp
item.description: The new Mercedes-AMG GT SUV is the first full-size SUV AMG developed entirely in-house in its 59-year history. The top GT 63 has three electric motors, 1,153 hp in U.S. trim, up to 710 kW charging and a simulated V8 soundtrack.

item.title: Yale Study: Taurine Calmed Age-Related Inflammation in Mice
item.description: A new study in Cell found taurine levels rise with age in people, immune cells release up to 80% of theirs before an inflammatory alarm, and extra taurine improved signs of healthy aging in old mice. It hasn't been tested as a treatment in people.

item.title: BYD's New Seagull EV Starts at $9,800 in China, With 5-Minute Charging on Pricier Trims
item.description: BYD launched the second-generation Seagull in China on October 20 from 65,900 yuan (about $9,800). It's bigger, seats five and is rear-wheel drive, and its three bigger-battery trims add Flash Charging that goes from 10% to 70% in five minutes.

item.title: Personalized mRNA Vaccine Cut Melanoma Recurrence-or-Death Risk by 42% in a Phase 3 Trial
item.description: Merck and Moderna's investigational mRNA shot intismeran, added to Keytruda after melanoma surgery, lowered the risk of the cancer returning or death by 42% versus Keytruda alone in the phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial. It is not approved yet, and survival data are still coming.

item.title: Tesla's Cybercab Expands Beyond Austin, and Dallas Is Next
item.description: On its Q3 earnings call, Tesla said its two-seat Cybercab robotaxi expands to Dallas next month, with more cities and fleet sales by the end of 2026. NHTSA is still reviewing whether a car with no brake pedal or mirrors meets federal rules.

item.title: SpaceX Will Try to Catch the WHOLE Starship on Flight 15
item.description: On its Oct 20 earnings call, SpaceX said Starship Flight 15 (targeting November) will try to catch both the Super Heavy booster and the Starship upper stage with the tower's chopsticks. FAA license still pending.

item.title: Sunday Rocket Matinee: Falcon 9 Hauls Three SES O3b mPOWER Sats
item.description: SpaceX is targeting Sunday Sep 13 for a Falcon 9 launch of three SES O3b mPOWER satellites from Cape Canaveral — the first triple mPOWER stack — window open 2:49 p.m. ET. A consumer guide to the afternoon broadband rocket.

item.title: Starship Flight 14 Is One Week Out — On the FAA Calendar, Anyway
item.description: Airspace advisories still point to Friday Sep 18 (~12:15–14:14 UTC) with Sep 19 backup for Starship Flight 14 — while SpaceX hasn’t locked a public webcast or date. Here’s the countdown-week checklist, not another mission remake.

item.title: Tesla’s New FSD Trick: A Panic Button That Presses Itself
item.description: FSD Supervised v14.3.9 is rolling out with Automatic Collision Evasion on HW4—FSD can jump in while you’re driving manually if a crash looks imminent or you’re not attentive. Here’s the lighthearted consumer take.

item.title: FSD v14 Just Got ACE — Ashok Says v15 Is the Real Leap
item.description: Hours after FSD v14.3.9’s Automatic Collision Evasion rollout chatter, Tesla AI lead Ashok Elluswamy previewed v15: earlier hazard prediction, faster reactions, and better collision avoidance. Here’s the light, hopeful consumer take.

item.title: Tesla Just Said ‘Go for Launch’ — Roadster Reveal Locked for October 1
item.description: Tesla posted “Go for launch” with a 10.01 graphic and a countdown on the Roadster page. After years of delays since the Nov 2017 debut, the next-gen sports car finally has a reveal date — thruster lore included. Here’s the evening poll.

item.title: Apple Says iPhone Duo Is ‘Like Two Products’ — So… Would You Pay $1,999?
item.description: A day after the unveil, Apple executives defended the iPhone Duo’s $1,999 sticker, the foldable display, and the secrecy. Preorders Oct 16, ships Oct 23.

item.title: Starship Flight 14: First Real Orbit + Starlink V3 That Actually Stays Up
item.description: SpaceX’s FCC paperwork points to a mid-September window for Starship Flight 14—the program’s first full orbital profile and the first shot at parking Starlink V3 sats in a staying orbit.

item.title: Cybertruck + Powerwall 3: Tesla Just Made Multi-Day Home Backup a Team Sport
item.description: Tesla’s Cybertruck Powershare can now back up a home together with Powerwall 3—extending outage runtime by more than three days. Here’s what changed and why it matters.

item.title: NASA and IBM just open-sourced a foundation model for the Moon
item.description: On September 10, 2026, NASA and IBM released a lunar AI foundation model on Hugging Face — craters, volcanic quirks, polar ice, and why that ice matters.

item.title: Apple’s iPhone Duo is real — foldable, $1,999, ships October 23
item.description: Apple unveiled its first foldable iPhone on September 9, 2026. Here’s the price, ship date, and how it sits next to iPhone 18 Pro.

item.title: Starlink at home and in your pocket: what’s real in 2026
item.description: Dish broadband and Direct-to-Cell are both real — but they’re not one magical plan yet. Here’s the clear, accurate split for home internet vs phone satellite.
